comments.name: Yuki Tanaka
comments.text: As someone who lives in Tokyo, I'd add Yanaka to Day 1 — it's an old shitamachi neighbourhood that survived WWII and feels like a different era. The shopping street (Yanaka Ginza) is fantastic.

comments.name: Rui Santos
comments.text: Estive 3 dias em Tóquio em abril — os jardins de Shinjuku na época das cerejeiras são absolutamente deslumbrantes. Confirmo o Senso-ji de manhã cedo antes das multidões. Itinerário excelente!

comments.name: Hannah Brooks
comments.text: Tokyo Tower at sunset is gorgeous but Skytree gives a better 360° view if you can only do one. Loved the Meiji Shrine walk — so peaceful even on a busy Saturday.
